title: Uniform and Regiment
author: Beatrix Oyelaran
blurb: Freya Quintana, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
